title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: While signed in to Fab, press Download on each of Epic's four free MetaHuman footwear files and save them in F:\LedgerTools\fab (about 1.2 GB in all).
sections.recommendation: Download all four: Epic's boots for Tom's toe shape (your yes of 31 October), the others for the cast. I look at each before using it.

sections.name: May I make one more try at the pale line where anything meets the wet street? Three tries on Tom's boots failed; it comes from the wet ground's water layer at every contact, so this try would be in the ground's material.
sections.recommendation: Yes: the line shows under every foot and object on the wet street, and the corner's wet ground needs it gone.

sections.name: In the Claude app's sidebar, open the session "LEDGER: read back page answers (nightly)" (stuck since 26 October) and press Stop, so the nightly read-back of your answers can run again.
sections.recommendation: Stop it: it has blocked every nightly run since 27 October; I read your answers by hand meanwhile. There is no web link for a session; it is in the app's sidebar.
